# Rule-to-Evidence Map

Use this map to keep a conclusion tied to the source that constrains it and to the example that illustrates its scope. It does not convert an example or a clean instrumented run into a universal proof.

| Rule                                                                                                    | Primary source scope                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            | Worked example                                                                                                                     | Evidence limit                                                                                                |
| ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| Callback work and output obligations follow the selected host lifecycle and buffer contract.            | CLAP `plugin.h` lifecycle callbacks, `audio-buffer.h` `clap_audio_buffer`, `audio-ports.h` port configuration, `thread-pool.h` task execution, and `process.h` `clap_process`; JUCE `AudioProcessor::processBlock` and PortAudio callback contracts.            | [Two inputs, three outputs, and a worker](../comprehensive/audio-thread-rules.md#example-two-inputs-three-outputs-and-a-worker).   | The example covers its declared layout and bounds only.                                                       |
| Ordinary shared payload needs ownership or a synchronization protocol before concurrent access.         | C++ `[intro.races]` data-race rules and Rust `std::sync::atomic` module ordering documentation.                                                                                                                                                                 | [Three display blocks](../comprehensive/lock-free-buffers.md#example-three-display-blocks).                                        | SPSC does not cover a second producer or an unbounded payload operation.                                      |
| Acquire and release edges authorize payload observation and reuse only when the protocol connects them. | C++ `std::memory_order` acquire/release semantics, Rust `Ordering::{Acquire, Release}`, and Zig 0.16 `std.atomic.Order` acquire/release definitions.                                                                                                            | [Rust AtomicU8 slot states](../comprehensive/memory-ordering.md#example-rust-atomicu8-slot-states).                                | The stated Rust version and target do not establish a proof for another language or target.                   |
| A tool result applies only to reached, instrumented paths and a control needs its intended diagnostic.  | Clang ThreadSanitizer, AddressSanitizer, UndefinedBehaviorSanitizer, RealtimeSanitizer `[[clang::nonblocking]]`, and Function Effect Analysis diagnostic documentation.                                                                                         | [A control record, not a general result](../comprehensive/verifying-concurrency.md#example-a-control-record-not-a-general-result). | A clean run does not prove all schedules, paths, lifetimes, or deadline bounds.                               |
| Released IDs and host transitions remain compatibility contracts.                                       | CLAP `params.h` parameter and rescan flags, `state.h` stream state, `latency.h` `changed`, and `audio-ports.h` rescan APIs; VST3 `IParamValueQueue`; Audio Unit parameter addresses; clap-wrapper `auv2.h` and `wrapasauv2.cpp` mapping at the pinned revision. | [Preset with pending latency](../comprehensive/parameters-and-state.md#example-preset-with-pending-latency).                       | The AUv2 mapping is pinned to one wrapper revision and needs a host fixture for compatibility evidence.       |
| Event timing, output status, automation curves, and smoothing follow the selected format's contract.    | CLAP `events.h` event headers and `clap_event_transport`, `process.h` `steady_time` and process statuses, `tail.h` tail extension; VST3 `IParamValueQueue`; AU `AUInternalRenderBlock`; JUCE `SmoothedValue`.                                                   | [Bounded two-block trace](../comprehensive/events-and-timing.md#example-bounded-two-block-trace).                                  | The trace defines one policy and does not promise delivery after a host stops offering output opportunities.  |
| A host-independent boundary needs a check that rejects the prohibited dependency or signature.          | The selected build system's dependency-policy rule and interface-signature assertion; fosforo `core` interface assertion as a scoped case study.                                                                                                                | [Enforced Rust core boundary](../comprehensive/the-pure-core-seam.md#example-enforced-rust-core-boundary).                         | Directory layout or core-vector success alone does not establish adapter correctness or transitive isolation. |
